title: FedMentor: Domain-Aware Differential Privacy for Heterogeneous Federated LLMs in Mental Health
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of differential privacy and federated learning for LLMs in the mental health domain. While it discusses safety and toxicity in a clinical context, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral systems, or formal ethical frameworks beyond a general discussion of data privacy regulations like HIPAA and GDPR.
